label: Diagram D7
caption: Diagram D7 Free area of smoke ventilators | E
description: Diagram D7, titled Free area of smoke ventilators, has two parts. Part a. is a side view of an open hinged vent angled upwards from a wall. A dashed line runs through the opening at an angle, marked with a 90° right-angle symbol at the wall. A green double-headed arrow, labelled Free area measured at right angles to air flow, stretches diagonally from the upper edge of the raised panel to the right-hand edge of the wall opening, perpendicular to that dashed line. Part b. is an elevation of a louvred vent showing four angled black slats set in a wall. Above the slats, five short green double-headed arrows, labelled a1, a2, a3, a4 and a5, measure the open gaps: a1 and a5 measure the gap between a slat and the edge of the opening, while a2, a3 and a4 measure the gaps between the slats. A text label above reads Free area for louvred vent = a 1 +a 2 +a 3 +a 4 +a 5.
